verdict.label: Self-serve
verdict.summary: GitHub OAuth apps are entirely self-serve and can be created instantly in developer settings without a manual review queue.

composioFit.summary: Composio provides a managed OAuth app for GitHub, allowing you to skip custom app registration entirely unless you require custom scopes, custom branding, or isolated rate limits.
whyOwnApp: You need your own app name on OAuth consent screens.
You're connecting to a custom instance.

phases.name: Register OAuth App
steps: Go to your GitHub settings under Developer settings -> OAuth apps.
Fill out the application name, homepage URL, and authorization callback URL.
phases.handoff: Copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard.

phases.name: Configure Composio Auth Config
steps: Open the Composio dashboard and navigate to auth configs.
Create a custom auth config for GitHub.
Paste your Client ID and Client Secret from GitHub.
phases.handoff: Initiate the connection flow using your Composio session.

artefacts.title: GitHub OAuth App Registration Values
artefacts.body:
Application name: My AI Agent (or your product name)
Homepage URL: https://yourdomain.com
Application description: AI agent integration via Composio
Authorization callback URL: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

scopes.purpose: Grants full access to public and private repositories including read and write access to code, commit statuses, and webhooks.
Grants read/write access to profile info only.
Requests an expiring access token and a refresh token.

redirectRules.rule: You can enter up to 10 callback URLs.

blockers.symptom: requests to generate new access tokens will be temporarily blocked, and you may receive error responses.
blockers.cause: Exceeding the limit of 2,000 access token requests per hour for OAuth apps.
blockers.fix: Cache tokens and avoid repeated sign-in loops.
blockers.fallback: Use Composio-managed app which handles shared quotas.

blockers.symptom: the next sign in within the same hour will require re-authorization of the application.
blockers.cause: An app signs the user in ten times within one hour, often indicating an infinite authentication loop.
blockers.fix: Debug application logic to stop redundant automatic sign-in attempts.

blockers.symptom: temporary code will expire after 10 minutes
blockers.cause: Failing to exchange the authorization code for an access token within the 10-minute window.
blockers.fix: Ensure token exchange POST request executes immediately after redirect.

checklist.text: Navigate to Developer settings -> OAuth apps in your GitHub account.
Fill in the app name, homepage, and the callback URL from Composio.
Generate and save the Client Secret securely.
Input the Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio custom auth config.

uncertainties: Whether GitHub enforces any hidden verification steps for high-volume public OAuth apps beyond standard rate limits.

claims.text: GitHub OAuth apps can be created directly by any personal account or organization administrator without review queues.
claims.quote: You can create and register an OAuth app under your personal account or under any organization you have administrative access to.

claims.text: OAuth apps are immediately active upon registration.
claims.reason: Standard behavior for GitHub OAuth app registration as documented in S1.

claims.text: Composio-managed OAuth is available for GitHub.
Using your own OAuth app changes app ownership, branding, scopes, and provider quota.
claims.quote: Choosing your own OAuth app changes app ownership, branding, scopes, and provider quota

claims.text: In the left sidebar, click OAuth apps, then Register a new application.
claims.quote: In the left sidebar, click OAuth apps . If you haven't created an app before, this button will say, Register a new application .

claims.text: You can enter up to 10 callback URLs in the Authorization callback URL field.
claims.quote: You can enter up to 10 callback URLs. To add additional callback URLs, click Add callback URL .

claims.text: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio from the provider developer portal.
claims.quote: For OAuth toolkits, register an app in the provider's developer portal and add the redirect URI from the dashboard. Then copy the Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio.

claims.text: Only use information in your OAuth app that you consider public.
claims.quote: Only use information in your OAuth app that you consider public. Avoid using sensitive data, such as internal URLs, when creating an OAuth app.

claims.text: The repo scope grants full access to public and private repositories including read and write access to code, commit statuses, and webhooks.
claims.quote: repo Grants full access to public and private repositories including read and write access to code, commit statuses, repository invitations, collaborators, deployment statuses, and repository webhooks

claims.text: The user scope grants read/write access to profile info only.
claims.quote: user Grants read/write access to profile info only.

claims.text: The offline_access scope requests an expiring access token and a refresh token.
claims.quote: offline_access Requests an expiring access token and a refresh token, even if your OAuth app is not configured to use expiring tokens.

claims.text: You can enter up to 10 callback URLs.
claims.quote: You can enter up to 10 callback URLs.

claims.quote: If an app signs the user in ten times within one hour, the next sign in within the same hour will require re-authorization of the application.
